name: Dockside Dreams
description: Wake up to stunning water views and watch dolphins play right from your private dock. This magnificent waterfront home features a heated pool and spa, gourmet kitchen, and direct water access.
tagline: Waterfront pool home with a private dock, bay access, and easy beach days.

featuredReview.text: This home was by far the best we have ever rented. We saw Manatees and Dolphins right from the back porch!! The home was absolutely beautiful, and decorated to a T!
featuredReview.author: Kate O'Hara

name: The Oasis
description: The ultimate gathering spot features a massive pool, TWO hot tubs, private mini golf course, pool table, and endless entertainment options.
tagline: Big-group Bradenton home with a pool, two hot tubs, mini golf, and room for everyone.

featuredReview.text: Brianne was an amazing host, always friendly, responsive and helpful. The place was very nice allowing our family of 6 to be completely comfortable enjoying all parts inside and outside of the house.
featuredReview.author: Felipe

name: Sarasota Luxe
description: Sophisticated Florida living in downtown Sarasota. Walk to St. Armands Circle, visit the Ringling Museum, then retreat to your private pool oasis.
tagline: Downtown Sarasota luxury with a screened pool, hot tub, and room for 12.

featuredReview.text: Excellent place for a large family or group of friends. Very family friendly with beds and high chairs for the little ones. Convenient location right next to a park and 15 minutes from the beach. Highly recommend!
featuredReview.author: Alondra

name: River House
description: Escape to this tranquil riverfront retreat featuring a private pool, spa, and game room. Watch stunning sunsets over the water from your private backyard paradise.
tagline: Quiet Bradenton retreat with a pool, spa, game room, and nature close by.

featuredReview.text: This is the nicest place we've stayed in Florida. For the birder, naturalist, kayaker, or fisherman — this place has it. Jim was a perfect host. Place was very clean and well furnished. We'll be going back!
featuredReview.author: Gary

name: Bradenton Pool Home
description: Book this Bradenton pool home direct and save 10-15%. Three bedrooms, 3.5 baths, a heated pool, in-ground spa, outdoor grill area, and easy access to IMG Academy.
tagline: IMG-friendly pool home with a spa, outdoor grill, and easy family setup.

featuredReview.text: Perfect home for our trip. Quiet neighborhood, convenient to everything. So comfortably appointed — felt at home the moment we arrived. The outside space is even better than the pictures. Highly recommend!
featuredReview.author: Susan
